title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1983-10-12
source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:08112) SBD > Cassette Master > Dat x 2 > CDR > SHN; Audience (shnid:91125) Recording Info: (FOB) Sennheiser 441 + (1) Neumann U87 -> Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550) -> Dat (48k) Transfer Info:Dat (Sony R500) -> Sound Devices 744T -> Samplitude Professional v10.02 -> FLAC; Recorded By Rob Eaton,Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1983 show with killer Jerry Garcia playing, captured on a clear matrix recording
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the 1983 performance, calling it energetic, jam‑filled and “outstanding,” especially noting Jerry’s filthy guitar work. The Dusborne matrix source is praised as “pure gold” and generally good sounding, making the set enjoyable from start to finish.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed, consistently positive reviews highlight an excellent performance and a solid matrix recording; average user rating is 4.5 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear matrix mix with solid balance; reviewers describe the sound as good to “pure gold,” indicating a clean, listenable recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic first set that builds into a smoking second half, overall strong and jam‑heavy performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as “filthy” and outstanding; his guitar work is a highlight.
